description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Dr. Mundo''' injects himself with chemicals to become enhanced for 10 seconds, gaining increased [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] '''base''' health, [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed, and [[File:Health regeneration icon.svg|15px|link=Health regeneration]] '''bonus''' health regeneration.
description.text: Active: Dr. Mundo injects himself with chemicals to become enhanced for 10 seconds, gaining increased  base health,  bonus movement speed, and  bonus health regeneration.

description2.raw: At rank 3, ''Maximum Dosage's'' increased '''base''' health and '''bonus''' health regeneration are both increased by 5% for each enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] within 1200 units at the time of cast.
description2.text: At rank 3, Maximum Dosage's increased base health and bonus health regeneration are both increased by 5% for each enemy champion within 1200 units at the time of cast.

notes.raw: * The health regeneration granted by ''Maximum Dosage'' adjusts dynamically to '''Dr. Mundo's''' '''maximum''' health. * The health regeneration granted by ''Maximum Dosage'' is special cased to be increased by [[File:Axiom Arcanist rune.png|20xpx|link=Axiom Arcanist|An icon representing Axiom Arcanist]] [[Axiom Arcanist]]. * ''Maximum Dosage'' will end prematurely upon entering [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|resurrection]]. * Against 5 champions, Rank 3 ''Maximum Dosage'' will heal 85% '''Maximum''' health regeneration & 50% '''Missing''' Bonus health
notes.text:
The health regeneration granted by Maximum Dosage adjusts dynamically to Dr. Mundo's maximum health.
The health regeneration granted by Maximum Dosage is special cased to be increased by Axiom Arcanist.
Maximum Dosage will end prematurely upon entering resurrection.
Against 5 champions, Rank 3 Maximum Dosage will heal 85% Maximum health regeneration & 50% Missing Bonus health
